Introduction

DGNA (previously known as The B.O.S.S) was a three-member boy group. Originally consisting of five members (Mika, Karam, Hyunmin, Injun, and Jay) they made their debut on March 4, 2010 with the single "Admiring Boy". Members Mika and Hyunmin later parted ways with the group around 2018.

In February 2023, the three remaining members participated in the show Peak Time as Team 23:00 but chose to withdraw after the third round. Later on December 21, 2023, New Ways Company announced that it had signed exclusive contracts with former DGNA members Karam, Injun, and Jay. According to the company, "Karam, Injun, and Jay will form a new group with additional members and return with new music in the first half of 2024."
